description: This file contains the implementation of the ClusterMembershipService class, which manages and updates cluster membership information within the Orleans runtime. It includes methods for snapshot retrieval, refreshing membership data, processing membership updates asynchronously, and lifecycle management.

classes.name: ClusterMembershipService
classes.description: Implements cluster membership management, including updating and providing snapshots of the cluster state, handling membership updates asynchronously, and integrating with the Orleans silo lifecycle.

methods.name: CurrentSnapshot
methods.description: Returns the current cluster membership snapshot, updating it if the underlying membership table has advanced.

methods.name: MembershipUpdates
methods.description: Provides an asynchronous stream of membership snapshots as they are updated.

methods.name: Refresh
methods.description: Refreshes the membership information up to a specific target version, with an overload that accepts a cancellation token.

methods.name: TryKill
methods.description: Attempts to kill a silo identified by its address, indicating failure or removal from the cluster.

methods.name: ProcessMembershipUpdates
methods.description: Asynchronous method that processes ongoing membership updates, handling exceptions, and logging events.

methods.name: Participate
methods.description: Registers the service to the silo lifecycle, starting and stopping the membership update processing accordingly.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Disposes resources such as the updates enumerable.
